identified_design_error: Original synthetic train generator allowed every (left,right) pair among 225 possible AST combinations. 3200 training cases almost surely expose all pairs, making precommitted synthetic-compositional novelty impossible independent of model quality.
resolution_BEFORE_FIRST_external: Keep the historical first synthetic weights; add fixed reserved pairs predicate (left+3*right)%5==0, exclude all such pairs from 3200 train AST labels, use ONLY these pairs for 320 synthetic-validation tasks. Train a fresh own-weight v2 checkpoint, freeze SHA before opening any of the eight external SyGuS source bodies. Do not change external target file hashes/denominator, 32-candidate budget, strong full 225 classical baseline, correctness test or model architecture.
scientific_implication: No new external evaluation has occurred at this amendment, so no post-outcome tuning of external SyGuS. Training v1 source-only experiment remains immutable and not promoted to v2; v2 external first will be single.
